system.description:
Ability Score Increases. +1 to Intelligence and one other ability score.

Tool Proficiency. Jeweler’s tools.

Skill Proficiencies. Investigation and your choice of Culture or History.

Suggested Equipment (cost 37 gp): Jeweler’s tools, Dungeoneer’s Pack.

Feature: Accurate Appraisal. You have an exceptional eye for exquisite gems. You have advantage on any checks made to appraise the value of gems or valuable jewelry found in treasure hoards. You may always choose to use Intelligence for these checks.

Adventures and Advancement: Treasure Hunter. As tales of your eye for quality spread, locals may approach you and your allies with tales of hidden treasure hoards or ancient baubles lost in caves or at sea. You eventually attract the services of 1 seasoned porter who acts as your follower.

Connection and Memento. Roll 1d10, choose, or make up your own.
